meta.name: hypogenic
meta.description: Automated LLM-driven hypothesis generation and testing on tabular datasets. Use when you want to systematically explore hypotheses about patterns in empirical data (e.g., deception detection, content analysis). Combines literature insights with data-driven hypothesis testing. For manual hypothesis formulation use hypothesis-generation; for creative ideation use scientific-brainstorming.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动生成并检验数据中的假设模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要系统性地探索表格数据中的规律并验证假设。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically generate and test hypotheses on tabular data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically explore patterns in tabular data and test hypotheses.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的表格数据自动生成并测试科学假设。它可以从数据中挖掘模式，也能结合文献中的理论，帮你系统性地探索问题（比如识别假新闻、检测欺骗行为）。
howto.when: 当你需要从数据中找出规律、验证想法，或者想结合已有研究来提出新假设时，可以请Claude帮忙。比如在做内容分析、心理指标预测等实证研究时。

say.text: 帮我从这份酒店评论数据中生成20个关于欺骗性评论的假设。
结合我提供的10篇论文，对这份AI生成文本检测数据生成假设并测试。
say.note: Claude会使用HypoRefine方法，融合文献和数据。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically generate and test scientific hypotheses from your tabular data. It can mine patterns from data and integrate literature insights to systematically explore questions like fake news detection or deception detection.
howto.when_en: Use when you need to discover patterns in data, validate ideas, or combine existing research to propose new hypotheses. Suitable for empirical research such as content analysis or mental health prediction.

say_en.text: Generate 20 hypotheses about deceptive reviews from this hotel review dataset.
say_en.note: Claude will use HypoGeniC to generate hypotheses from data.

say_en.text: Combine these 10 papers with the AI-generated text dataset to generate and test hypotheses.
say_en.note: Claude will use HypoRefine to integrate literature and data.
